title_ar: الشيخ الددو يحاضر عن "خصائص الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأمته" بلكصر
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures on 'The Distinctive Qualities of the Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him) and of His Community' in Ksar
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء مساء أمس السبت 07 ربيع الأول 1434هـ الموافق 19 يناير 2013 م بمسجد بداه بمقاطعة لكصر، محاضرة هامة حول"خصائص الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأمته" استمرت ساعتين، وقد شهدت إقبالا لافتا من الرجال والنساء اكتظ منه الجامع، وسد الطرق المؤدية إليه

و قد تناولت المحاضرة المواضيع التالية:

*-اختيار الله تعالى لرسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم.

*-وأبرز الخصائص التي اختصه بها سبحانه وتعالى كالشفاعة الكبرى والصغرى والوسطى،

وخصائص أمته؛ فهم الآخرون الساقون يوم القيامة، وعملهم فليل و أجرهم مضاعف..

وتحدث الشيخ خلال المحاضرة عن مراتب الشهادة. و جوالب المحبة التي حصرها في: الجمال والإحسان، والخلق، والرجاء، والعلاقة، وكيف اجتمعت في رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

وقد استطرد قصصا في محبته صلى الله عليه وسلم.. مؤكدا أن الإقبال على الله تعالى علاج نهائي للفقر والحاجة.

وأوضح الشيخ الددو أن الدعاة إلى الله تعالى هم ورثة الأنبياء، و أنه يكفي آخر هذه الأمة شرفا قوله تعالى: "وآخرين منهم لما يلحقوا بهم"

وقوله -صلى الله عليه وسلم- لأصحابه: "أنتم في زمان من نقص فيه عن عُشُر ما أمر به هلك، وسيأتي على الناس زمان من أتى فيه بعشر ما أمر به نجا".

-وقد أم الشيخ الحاضرين في صلاة العشاء، و دعا إلى تخفيف الزحام في الصفوف، معتبرا أن شدة الزحام لاتتأتى معها إقامة الصلاة المطلوبة، مما دعى لخروج كثيرين للصلاة خارج المسجد!

وبعد الصلاة أجاب على أسئلة الحضور، وختم بدعاء جامع مؤثر..
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered yesterday evening, Saturday 07 Rabiʿ al-Awwal 1434 AH, corresponding to 19 January 2013, at the Bedah Mosque in the district of Ksar, an important lecture on 'The Distinctive Qualities of the Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him) and of His Community', which lasted two hours and saw a striking turnout of men and women, so that the congregational mosque was packed and the roads leading to it were blocked

The lecture took up the following subjects:

*- God the Exalted's choosing of His Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him).

*- And the most prominent distinctive qualities with which He, glorified and exalted, singled him out, such as the greater, the lesser and the intermediate intercession,

and the distinctive qualities of his community: they are the last [in time], the foremost on the Day of Resurrection; their work is little and their reward is multiplied…

During the lecture the Sheikh spoke about the ranks of bearing witness, and about the things that draw love, which he confined to: beauty, doing good, character, hope and relationship — and how these came together in the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him)

He went on at length with stories about love for him (peace and blessings be upon him)… affirming that turning to God the Exalted is a final remedy for poverty and need.

Sheikh al-Dedew explained that those who call people to God the Exalted are the heirs of the prophets, and that it is honour enough for the last of this community that God the Exalted says: { and others of them who have not yet joined them } (Sūrat al-Jumuʿah 62:3)

and that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to his Companions: 'You are in a time in which whoever falls short of a tenth of what he is commanded will perish; and a time will come upon people in which whoever brings a tenth of what he is commanded will be saved.'

- The Sheikh led those present in the night prayer (ʿishāʾ), and called for the crowding in the rows to be eased, holding that with such severe crowding the prayer cannot be performed as it is required to be — which led many to go out and pray outside the mosque!

After the prayer he answered the questions of those present, and closed with a comprehensive and moving supplication…

flags.context: listing the distinctive qualities of the Prophet's community
options: the last [in time], the foremost on the Day of Resurrection (reading الساقون as a misprint for السابقون)
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). 'الساقون' is not a word that fits; the phrase is the well-known prophetic saying 'نحن الآخِرون السابقون يوم القيامة' — the last of the communities in time, the first to be judged on the Day of Resurrection. Translated by the evident sense and flagged; 'body_ar' preserves the source spelling. The same paragraph has 'فليل' for 'قليل'.

flags.context: وتحدث الشيخ خلال المحاضرة عن مراتب الشهادة
options: the degrees of the testimony of faith
flags.note: شهادة carries all three senses and the one-line summary gives no context to settle which. In a lecture on the Prophet's distinctive qualities, 'bearing witness' (as in the community bearing witness over mankind, Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:143) fits well, but martyrdom is at least as likely in a Mauritanian lecture of this period. Rendered neutrally as 'bearing witness'. DO NOT publish without the lecture audio being checked — the three senses point in very different directions.

flags.arabic: جوالب المحبة … الجمال والإحسان، والخلق، والرجاء، والعلاقة
flags.context: the five things the Sheikh said draw love
options: beauty, doing good, character, hope and relationship
beauty, benefaction, moral character, expectation and kinship
beauty, excellence, disposition, hope and connection
flags.note: A five-item list compressed into single words by the reporter, with no gloss on any of them. 'العلاقة' in particular could be kinship, attachment or an established connection. Each is rendered with its most general English sense; the list should be checked against the lecture before it is presented as the Sheikh's own scheme.

flags.arabic: "أنتم في زمان من نقص فيه عن عُشُر ما أمر به هلك…"
flags.context: a prophetic report quoted in the lecture
options: translate the wording as printed, with no grading added
translate against the standard wording in the collections
flags.note: The report is known from al-Tirmidhi and others, usually with 'من ترك منكم عشر ما أمر به'. The reporter gives neither collection nor grading, and per style guide §4 none has been supplied. The wording here differs from the common form and is translated as printed.

translator_notes: News summary of a lecture; the substance is a reporter's list of headings, not the Sheikh's continuous words. Qur'anic rendering is interpretive and is not a substitute for the Arabic (style guide §4). The Hijri date given here, 07 Rabiʿ al-Awwal 1434, is matched to 19 January 2013, whereas article 820 matches the same Hijri date to 18 January 2013; both cannot be right. Source typos preserved in body_ar: 'الساقون' for 'السابقون', 'فليل' for 'قليل', 'دعى' for 'دعا'. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
